author: More Perfect Union
description:
Gas is still over $4, diesel is up over $6, and now Trump is buying diesel fuel from Russia.

The emergency fixes implemented as the international oil market was rocked by Trump's war on Iran are running out, and the full extent of the crisis is looming.

While Trump lies about the Strait of Hormuz, the world is bracing for the worst.

Host and Producer: @trevorp_hayes
Editor and Motion Graphics: Gina Barton
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The World is Running Out of Options to Fix the Oil Crisis

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Insiders at Meta and other companies leaked to us about bosses using AI to spy on them.

In tech, AI spies on workers, copies their work, and trains bots to replace them.

At a call center "Emotion AI" evaluates the way a nurse talks, and tells her she doesn't have empathy.
